name: cranberry-forge
description: Independent Three.js game-development tools and playable templates

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
scripts.samples: node scripts/render-samples.mjs && node scripts/render-game-samples.mjs && node scripts/render-objective-samples.mjs && node scripts/render-afterglow-sample.mjs && node scripts/render-expansion-samples.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write dist/*.js dist/*.css dist/*.html dist/kits/*.js dist/packages/*/*.js dist/packages/*/*.d.ts dist/templates/*/*.js dist/templates/*/*.mjs dist/templates/*/*.html dist/templates/*/*.css scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs
